llm.summary: This skill is a local note-collection web page that stores user-provided text and files in the browser and does not show network upload or hidden execution behavior.

dimensions.detail: The app uses browser localStorage and IndexedDB, clipboard APIs, FileReader, drag-and-drop, and download Blob creation; these are disclosed and proportionate for a local note board, but users should understand pasted text, uploaded text-file contents, and images persist locally in the browser.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains no executable install hook or dependency installation; it describes direct browser use of assets/word-doc.html and optional packaging through an external skill-creator tool.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to opening or distributing a single HTML asset and using it for user-directed note collection; there are no prompt-injection instructions, role overrides, hidden agent commands, or unrelated automation directives.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is local browser storage under disclosed keys plus IndexedDB image storage, with user-visible delete, trash, draft, and folder controls; no background worker, credential use, privilege escalation, or network exfiltration was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is a local front-end text collection, organization, and Word export tool; the inspected HTML implements paste/add, local folders, local preview/copy, deletion, image handling, and .docx export consistent with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a browser-local note and document organizer. Treat it as local persistent storage: sensitive pasted content, uploaded text documents, and images can remain in the browser until cleared, but the inspected artifact does not show uploading or remote access.
